caseNameFull: Hawaii Housing Authority v. Midkiff Portlock Community Assn. (Maunalua Beach) v. Midkiff and Kahala Community Assn., Inc. v. Midkiff

opinions.text:
Appeals from C. A. 9th Cir. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.

Reported below: 702 F. 2d 788.
